query:
UPDATE course_files
           SET folder = COALESCE($3, folder),
               name = COALESCE($4, name),
               updated_at = CASE
                   WHEN (COALESCE($3, folder), COALESCE($4, name)) IS DISTINCT FROM (folder, name)
                   THEN timestamptz 'epoch' + $5::bigint * interval '1 microsecond'
                   ELSE updated_at END
           WHERE org_id = $1 AND id = $2
